ingredients: 1/2 cup oats, 1 cup milk, 1/2 apple, 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 1/2 tbsp honey
cooking_instructions: Cook the oats with milk. Add chopped apple, cinnamon, and honey. Stir and serve warm.

ingredients: 2 slices bread, 1 egg, 1 slice cheese, 1/2 tsp butter, salt, black pepper
cooking_instructions: Toast the bread. Cook the egg in butter, season it, add cheese, and serve on the toast.

ingredients: 1 tortilla, 1/2 chicken breast, 1/2 avocado, 1/2 tomato, 1 tbsp yogurt, salt, black pepper
cooking_instructions: Cook and slice the chicken. Mash the avocado and fill the tortilla with chicken, avocado, tomato, and yogurt.

ingredients: 100 g pasta, 75 g mushrooms, 1/2 cup cooking cream, 1 garlic clove, 1/2 tbsp olive oil, salt, black pepper
cooking_instructions: Boil the pasta. Saute garlic and mushrooms, add cream and seasoning, then mix with the pasta.

ingredients: 1 salmon fillet, 1/2 lemon, 1/2 tbsp olive oil, 1 garlic clove, salt, black pepper
cooking_instructions: Season the salmon with lemon, olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper. Bake at 200 C until cooked through.

ingredients: 1/2 banana, 1 egg, 1/3 cup flour, 1/3 cup milk, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp butter
cooking_instructions: Mash the banana and mix with egg, flour, milk, and baking powder. Cook small pancakes in a buttered pan.

ingredients: 2/3 cup cooked rice, 1/3 carrot, 1/3 bell pepper, 1/6 cup peas, 2/3 egg, 2/3 tbsp soy sauce, 1/3 tbsp oil
cooking_instructions: Cook the vegetables in oil, add the egg and scramble. Add rice and soy sauce, then stir-fry until hot.

ingredients: 1/2 cup flour, 1/4 tsp yeast, 3 tbsp warm water, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 38 g mozzarella, 2 basil leaves
cooking_instructions: Prepare and rest the dough. Shape it, add tomato sauce and mozzarella, bake until golden, then add basil.

ingredients: 1/4 cup flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 1/4 egg, 1/8 orange, 1 tbsp cocoa powder, 1 tbsp butter, 1/8 tsp baking powder
cooking_instructions: Mix the dry and wet ingredients with orange zest and juice. Pour into a small baking dish and bake at 180 C.

ingredients: 1/2 cup yogurt, 1/2 cup strawberries, 1/4 cup granola, 1/2 tbsp honey
cooking_instructions: Layer yogurt, sliced strawberries, and granola in a glass. Drizzle with honey and serve.
